svg.text: Cut from 4 mm EVA foam: lay the shell on its side on the sheet and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: trace inside it, rolling it over; the flat pattern is a curved band

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 174 mm wide. Cut 2 mm inside the line and check in the shell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Punch the 12 mm holes through the shell's holes once glued in place,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 6.5 mm hole over each of the six screw heads so the foam lies flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: glued to the inside of the shell with its own adhesive back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: after the pack is screwed on (the screw heads sit in its holes).
